Muslim Sisters Retreat in Essaouira, Morocco 🌊☀️
📅 22-29 November 2026

A 7-day retreat for Muslim women to slow down, reconnect & build real sisterhood

What to expect:

✨ Sisterhood, deep talks & heart-to-heart conversations
🕌 Praying together, reconnecting with Allah & inner peace
🎨 Activities like horse riding, cooking class, hammam & exploring the Medina
🏡 Private villa & pool, fresh & healthy Moroccan meals & time offline
🌊 Beach walks, fun & free time to just be
title: 🇲🇦Morocco Sisters retreat
